Brightcom Group Added to FTSE Micro Cap Index

Brightcom Group has been included in the FTSE Global Equity Index Series Micro Cap Index. Following this announcement, shares of the company saw a jump of 9%. The inclusion signifies a change in the company's standing within global equity markets.
